title: an error of /v1/fleet/hooks
description: every refusal: 400, 401 (no rights to the configuration's writes), 403 (trust_required: a write that takes pairing's rights, as the settings interface refuses it; another site or origin), 404, 409 (exists, conflict, confirm_needed with `confirm`, `destination`, `lan`), 422 (invalid, kind_unavailable, with `field`), 503
